policy: Class selects geometry and vertical detail, never capacity. With no --vram-gib, measure actual total and free memory. Preserve recipe duration, cadence and minimum study extent; refuse a fitted footprint below that minimum. Controlled scenarios retain their declared ladder and 49 levels across classes.
intent_rule: No nests: regional. Otherwise preferred_finest_dx_km >= 3: mesoscale. Otherwise: storm. Controlled scenarios preserve exact geometry.

8.tradeoff: Local fine studies use a compact 4 to 1 km pair. Studies requiring at least 500 km of root context use 12 to 3 to 1 km: a coarser context domain buys coverage while preserving the fine focus. Native sizing enforces the required study span.

12.tradeoff: Regional studies request 9 km spacing. Fine studies requiring at least 500 km of root context use 12 to 3 to 1 km; local studies retain a compact 4 to 1 km pair. Available memory determines actual coverage.

16.tradeoff: Three-domain storm studies add a 12 km context domain around 3 km and 1 km nests; resident cost and preparation increase.

24.tradeoff: Regional studies request 3 km spacing; mesoscale studies add a 2 km inner nest. Storm studies spend available memory on fitted coverage.

32.tradeoff: The 24 GiB horizontal ladders with 64 vertical levels; extra vertical detail consumes memory and runtime, and actual free memory still controls coverage.
